name: OverSight
product: OverSight by Objective-See

evidence.says: Objective-See publishes OverSight 2.4.0 as an official release.

I inspected the embedded OverSight.app/Contents/MacOS/OverSight executable in the official installer ZIP and verified that bundle com.objective-see.oversight version 2.4.0 contains x86_64 and arm64 slices.

name: Silhouette Studio
product: Silhouette Studio by Silhouette America

evidence.says: Silhouette America lists 5.0.556 as its current Silhouette Studio release.
Silhouette Japan dates the 5.0.556 macOS build to November 5, 2026 and identifies 5.0.523 as the release that introduced universal support without Rosetta.
Silhouette America says its Universal Mac build contains x86_64 and Apple Silicon code and points to version 5.0.523.

notes: The 4.5-series scans predate the vendor's universal release.

name: yEd
product: yEd Graph Editor by yWorks

evidence.says: yWorks lists a macOS ARM installer for yEd Graph Editor 3.25.1 with an embedded OpenJDK 21 runtime.

notes: A separate Intel installer is also available.

name: Yandex.Disk.2
product: Yandex Disk 3.0 for macOS by Yandex

evidence.says: The cask lists build 3.2.53 (3373), the Yandex.Disk.2.app bundle, and a Rosetta requirement for the official download.
Yandex identifies the current macOS client as Yandex Disk 3.0.

limitation: The architecture and Rosetta requirement come from the cask maintainers.

name: Eddie
product: AirVPN Eddie Desktop Edition

evidence.says: AirVPN explains that the Eddie interface is x64 under Rosetta while its core components in the Apple silicon package are native ARM64.
The cask identifies Eddie 2.26.2 and explicitly requires Rosetta 2 for Eddie.app on Apple silicon.
AirVPN’s release metadata dates the stable Eddie 2.26.2 release to August 21, 2026.

notes: The ARM64 disk image filename describes a hybrid package whose main desktop UI still relies on Rosetta.

name: Cocktail
product: Cocktail Tahoe Edition by Maintain

evidence.says: Maintain lists Tahoe Edition 19.10.1 and says that current Cocktail releases rely on Rosetta while native Apple silicon support is in development.
Maintain names 19.10.1 as Tahoe Edition and reports testing it with macOS 26.7.2.

notes: This bundle ID identifies the Tahoe edition, which has its own version series.

name: Lunar Client
product: Lunar Client by Moonsworth

evidence.says: The vendor offers separate Apple silicon and Intel macOS downloads.
The versioned cask selects the vendor’s arm64 DMG for Apple Silicon and identifies com.moonsworth.client as the app bundle.
The vendor’s update manifest names the arm64 DMG for 3.8.1-ow and dates the release to November 25, 2026.

name: YouTube to MP3
product: YouTube to MP3 Converter by MediaHuman

evidence.says: The MediaHuman page identifies version 3.9.24 and links a separate macOS ARM download named YouTubeToMP3-arm.dmg.
The project's changelog dates version 3.9.24 to October 2, 2026.

name: Epson Data Collection Agent
product: Epson Data Collection Agent by Epson

evidence.says: Epson identifies the Data Collection Agent and Edca as software that obtains printer usage information for Epson.

notes: This is a printer telemetry helper.

name: Yandex
product: Yandex Browser by Yandex

evidence.says: Yandex provides distinct Mac downloads for Apple processors and Intel processors.
Yandex's official update feed dated November 16, 2026 identifies the 26.11.0.2030 build 121941 installer in its guidArm64 field.
The versioned cask selects 26.11.0.2030 on ARM and identifies the installed browser bundle as ru.yandex.desktop.yandex-browser.

name: TextExpander
product: TextExpander 3 Mac App Store edition by Smile (now TextExpander)

evidence.says: TextExpander says its Mac app is no longer available in the Mac App Store because the app cannot be sandboxed.
The current TextExpander Mac app is distributed directly by the vendor.

limitation: The final Mac App Store release and its architecture were not independently established.
notes: The scanned com.smileonmymac.textexpander.MacAppStore bundle identifies the retired store edition, separate from the current direct-download edition.

name: FLIR Tools
product: FLIR Tools for Mac by Teledyne FLIR

evidence.says: FLIR explicitly marks FLIR Tools desktop discontinued and says existing customers can still use their installations.

limitation: The final Mac release number and its architecture were not independently established.
notes: The vendor names the FLIR Thermal Studio suite as its successor.

name: Epson FastFoto
product: Epson FastFoto photo-scanning application by Seiko Epson

evidence.says: Epson publishes FastFoto 2.1.18 for macOS with a March 6, 2026 release date.

Epson lists FastFoto 2.1.16 and later as functional on Apple Silicon Macs running Tahoe, marks native support as planned, and explains that Intel apps in the table continue working after the system warning.
Epson lists FastFoto 2.1.18 and later as compatible with macOS 27 and records a known settings issue.

notes: Epson Scan 2 is a separate application with its own architecture.

name: DiffMerge
product: DiffMerge by SourceGear

evidence.says: SourceGear offers the stable DiffMerge 4.2.1 macOS disk image as an Intel build.
In a 2026 support thread, SourceGear explains that the existing Intel Mac build requires Rosetta 2.
SourceGear labels its newer release with a Mac arm64 asset as a pre-release.
SourceGear announced that DiffMerge 4.2.1 was available on October 15, 2015.

notes: The ARM64 build belongs to the 5.0.0.1 development release.

name: LycheeSlicer
product: Lychee Slicer by Mango 3D (Lychee)

evidence.says: The official download page offers separate ARM and Intel macOS installers for production release 8.0.5.
Lychee confirms that its ARM macOS installer is the Apple Silicon build.
The official changelog describes 8.0.5 and identifies November 16, 2026 as its publication date in the page metadata.

notes: Lychee Slicer 8 installs alongside the previous version.

name: WPXO
product: WPXO by Dale Gillard

evidence.says: Dale Gillard describes WPXO as a Mac menu bar app for accessing Microsoft Office documents and links its Mac App Store listing.
Apple’s catalog identifies com.dalegillard.wpxo as WPXO 1.1.3 and gives its January 2014 release date.
The live Mac App Store listing gives version 1.1.3 and a generic 64-bit processor requirement.

limitation: The catalog and vendor site do not state the binary architecture or Rosetta behavior.

name: Maltego 4.12.1
product: Maltego Graph Desktop by Maltego Technologies

evidence.says: The versioned cask links the official Maltego 4.14.1 Mac disk image and declares a Rosetta requirement.
Maltego identifies the scanned version 4.12.1 as a July 2026 release of Maltego Graph Desktop.

limitation: The architecture and Rosetta requirement are established by the cask maintainers.

name: HCL Notes
product: Notes by Apple

evidence.says: Apple documents its built-in Notes app for macOS 27 Golden Gate.
A direct inspection of the macOS 27 Notes bundle identifies com.apple.Notes version 4.13 build 3195 and reports the arm64e executable slices.
The developer of a third-party Notes CLI independently documents testing against Notes 4.13 build 3195 on arm64.

notes: The HCL Notes title and the notes-better cask point to different products. Rename this listing to Apple Notes.

name: Guardian Browser
product: Guardian Secure Proctoring Browser by Meazure Learning (ProctorU)

evidence.says: Meazure Learning links separate Apple silicon and Intel downloads for Guardian Browser.
The vendor’s macOS arm64 update manifest identifies Guardian Browser 5.0.0, dates it October 28, 2026, and names the arm64 DMG and ZIP.

name: Canon IJScanner6
product: Canon IJScanner6 Image Capture Architecture driver

evidence.says: Canon identifies the ijscanner6 package as a scanner driver used with Image Capture.

notes: The .app bundle is part of a scanner driver package.

name: Canon IJScanner4
product: Canon IJScanner4 Image Capture Architecture driver

evidence.says: Canon identifies the ijscanner4 package as a scanner driver used with Image Capture.

notes: The .app bundle is part of a scanner driver package.

name: Canon IJScanner2
product: Canon IJScanner2 Image Capture Architecture driver

evidence.says: Canon identifies the ijscanner2 package as a scanner driver used with Image Capture.

notes: The .app bundle is part of a scanner driver package.

name: Canvas X Draw
product: Canvas X Draw for macOS by Canvas GFX, now published by Vector GFX

evidence.says: Vector GFX documents the universal ARM and Intel build of Canvas X Draw 26 and dates the latest listed build 7592 to September 30, 2026.
Vector GFX lists version 26 and the archived version 7.1.1 in the same Canvas X Draw for macOS download table.

limitation: The vendor does not publish the bundle identifier for version 26.
notes: The first universal version was 26 build 7526 in March 2026. The scan in this listing was version 7.1.1.

name: EasyBatchPhoto
product: EasyBatchPhoto by Yellow Mug Software

evidence.says: Yellow Mug continues to link a downloadable Mac trial of its batch image-processing app.
I inspected EasyBatchPhoto.app/Contents/MacOS/EasyBatchPhoto in the vendor DMG and verified that bundle com.yellowmug.EasyBatchPhoto version 3.3 is x86_64 only.

limitation: I found no credible report confirming Rosetta operation for version 3.3.

name: World of Warcraft Launcher
product: World of Warcraft Launcher, a Blizzard Battle.net game bootstrapper

evidence.says: A crash report on Blizzard's official forum identifies World of Warcraft Launcher.app as bundle net.battle.bootstrapper.
Blizzard distributes Battle.net as the Mac desktop app that launches its games.

notes: The same bootstrapper bundle ID appears in this batch under World of Warcraft, Warcraft III, and Diablo III launcher filenames.

name: Bark
product: Bark Desktop App by Bark Technologies

evidence.says: Bark links its current Mac desktop build for monitoring children's iOS devices.
I inspected Bark.app/Contents/MacOS/Bark in the official DMG and verified that bundle us.bark.bark-desktop version 10.0.26 is x86_64 only.

limitation: Bark's public requirements list supported macOS versions, and I found no version-specific confirmation of operation under Rosetta.

name: LockDown Browser
product: LockDown Browser by Respondus

evidence.says: Respondus announced version 2.1.6.02 for Mac on November 17, 2026.
Respondus says the current Mac line is Intel-based and runs on Apple Silicon using Rosetta while a native build is in development.

limitation: The vendor's architecture advisory covers the current Mac line and does not name the 2.1.6.02 point release itself.

name: Distiller
product: Acrobat Distiller by Adobe

evidence.says: Adobe lists Distiller.app as an application installed by the macOS Acrobat package.
Adobe documents directly opening Acrobat Distiller in Finder to convert PostScript files on a Mac.
An Acrobat 2026.002.21931 user reported an arm64 Distiller executable after correcting their initial reading, without specifying the Distiller build.

limitation: A current Distiller-specific version and its executable architecture still need vendor confirmation or binary inspection.
notes: Distiller is a separately launched utility bundled with Acrobat.

name: Box of Books Reader
product: Box of Books Reader by Box of Books (Officeworks for Education)

evidence.says: Box of Books distributes its offline macOS reader as a DMG through participating schools' ebook portals.
The vendor still describes Mac, Windows and iOS offline reader editions.
The Box of Books website identifies the service as part of Officeworks for Education and directs users to sign in.

limitation: The installer is behind a school sign-in and public documentation gives no version or architecture.

name: OpenOffice
product: Apache OpenOffice by the Apache Software Foundation

evidence.says: Apache announces the Mac release of 4.1.17 on October 14, 2026.
Apache publishes the complete 4.1.17 Mac installer for x86-64.
Apache's release vote records a passing macOS build and test on an Apple Silicon Mac running Golden Gate.
Apache describes native macOS arm64 as a change in its OpenOffice 5 development branch.

name: ApplePi-Baker
product: ApplePi-Baker by Hans Luijten (Tweaking4All)

evidence.says: The developer lists stable 2.2.3 with its release date and publishes an x86-64 crash report for that exact bundle plus firsthand reports of the release running on M1 Macs.
The developer confirms running the 2.3.0 beta through Rosetta on an M1 Max and documents reports of failures with 2.2.3 on some Apple Silicon setups.

limitation: Users report that the stable build's helper or restore workflow can fail on some Apple Silicon systems.
notes: The 2.3.0 public download is labeled beta and the developer also reports using it via Rosetta.

name: aTrust
product: Sangfor aTrust zero-trust access client for macOS

evidence.says: Sangfor lists administrator downloads for platform-specific installers across the 2.4.10 to 2.5.16_SP5 release range.
An October 2026 report on Sangfor's forum identifies the exact com.sangfor.tray Mac client in deployment version 2.5.16 as x86_64 with Rosetta 2.
Sangfor documents its Intel Mac client requiring Rosetta on M-series hardware without specifying the client version.
A November 2026 inspection of a university's deployment identifies its Mac app as UI version 11.5.0 and finds its main tray executable x86_64 only.

limitation: The newest Mac package's architecture is unconfirmed because Sangfor gates its current installer matrix behind sign-in.
notes: Institutional deployments can ship different product and UI versions.

name: recoverit
product: RecoveritLoader by Wondershare

evidence.says: The uploaded bundle’s Info.plist identifies RecoveritLoader and points to a separate Recoverit.app nested inside Contents/MacOS.
Wondershare’s official product page describes the complete Recoverit data recovery application and lists its current major version as 15.

notes: The inner Recoverit.app has a separate executable and needs independent verification.

name: Avidemux2.8.app
product: Avidemux by the Avidemux project

evidence.says: The project lists 2.8.1v2 Monterey Qt6 as its stable Mac download and publishes the matching SHA-256.
SourceForge dates the official macOS 2.8.1v2 disk image to September 19, 2022.
Mach-O inspection of Avidemux_2.8.1.app/Contents/MacOS/Avidemux2.8 found only x86_64, and the app plist identifies Avidemux 2.8.1 and bundle ID Avidemux.org.
Homebrew documents Rosetta 2 for its stable Avidemux cask and currently marks the cask disabled.

limitation: The architecture comes from static inspection and the Rosetta requirement comes from Homebrew documentation.

name: Movavi Screen Recorder 22
product: Movavi Screen Recorder 22 for Mac by Movavi

evidence.says: Movavi release notes date 22.5.1 to September 1, 2022 and describe ARM hardware support only in the later 24.5.0 release.
Movavi provides download access for past purchases through a user account or purchase email.
Movavi says some Intel-based Mac installers and applications use Rosetta 2 without naming the Screen Recorder 22.5.1 build.

limitation: The executable architecture and Rosetta behavior of the exact 22.5.1 bundle remain unverified.
notes: The bundle ID identifies the separately licensed version 22.

name: AHM System Manager 1.61
product: AHM System Manager by Allen & Heath

evidence.says: The vendor lists macOS build 1.61, reports support through macOS Tahoe, and says Golden Gate is still unverified.
The vendor dates System Manager 1.61 to January 2026 and lists general hardware requirements.

limitation: The vendor did not state the Mac executable architecture or Rosetta behavior, and the disk image could not be retrieved for inspection.

name: Reigns
product: Reigns by Nerial, published by Devolver Digital

evidence.says: The publisher’s Steam listing identifies the anniversary update and continued availability for macOS.
A June 2026 Steam user report records successful play through Rosetta 2 on an M2 Mac with macOS Tahoe 26.5.1.
Steam depot history shows a public macOS update in August 2026, after the June compatibility report.

limitation: The Rosetta report covers an older build than the August anniversary update, whose executable architecture remains unverified.

name: Honeygain
product: Honeygain by Honeygain, UAB

evidence.says: Honeygain identifies its macOS release as a downloadable PKG installer.
Honeygain’s download dashboard points Mac users to the official Honeygain-1.5.4.pkg.
Inspection of the installed Honeygain.app/Contents/MacOS/Honeygain executable in the official PKG found x86_64 only, with bundle version 1.5.4 (41).

limitation: Successful Rosetta operation was not verified for the current 1.5.4 build.
notes: The package declares compatibility with both host architectures, while its main executable is Intel-only.

name: iLovePDF
product: iLovePDF Desktop by ILOVEPDF S.L.

evidence.says: iLovePDF directs Mac users to the Mac App Store for its desktop app.
The Mac-specific App Store listing gives version 2.3.6 with a November 9, 2026 release date and macOS 12 or later as the OS requirement.

limitation: The Mac App Store omits CPU architecture, and direct Mac installers are available through the vendor’s sales team.

name: thinkorswim
product: thinkorswim desktop by Charles Schwab

evidence.says: Charles Schwab provides the official thinkorswim desktop installer for macOS.

Static inspection of the installer’s embedded 0.dat ZIP found the exact bundle com.install4j.9968-4488-2169-7623.18 at version 1994.1.16 with both arm64 and x86_64 slices in thinkorswim.app/Contents/MacOS/JavaApplicationStub.

notes: The desktop launcher and the separate installer both have universal binaries in this release.
